fields.label: Voxel size (m)
fields.help: Edge length of the subsampling voxel. Smaller keeps more points.

fields.label: Minimum points per voxel
fields.help: Voxels with fewer points than this are dropped as noise.

fields.label: Representative point
fields.help: Which point represents a voxel: its centroid, the real point nearest the centroid, or the first point encountered.

fields.label: Keep intensity
fields.help: Carry the intensity field through to the output cloud.

fields.label: Output file name
fields.help: Written inside the run folder. Extension decides the LAS/LAZ format.
